The published V2 client and documentation currently use an unencrypted HTTP API, while the linked HTTPS V2 host and client repository are unavailable. NED host queries require one unambiguous host identity; transient coordinates are not silently substituted.

NED states that high-volume automated access is best-effort, so this adapter is single-threaded, starts at most one request per second, and never queries proprietary or user-account holdings.
